item.title: Ohio State Offensive Lineman Justin Terry Entering Transfer Portal After One Year with Buckeyes
item.description: Justin Terry is back in the transfer portal for the second time in two years. After transferring to Ohio State from West Virginia last season, Justin Terry re-entered the transfer portal on Tuesday. According to On3, Terry entered the portal with a “do not contact” tag, which typically indicates that a player has a specific destination in mind. item.description: Ohio State should be exploring its options for potential additions at every position in this year’s transfer portal, but some positions carry more pressing needs than others. As of Tuesday afternoon, the Buckeyes had added three transfers for the 2026 season: former UCF defensive tackle John Walker, former Ohio tight end Mason Williams and former UCF long snapper Dalton Riggs. item.title: Ohio State Wide Receiver Carnell Tate Declares for the 2026 NFL Draft
item.description: Ohio State has had a wide receiver selected in the first round in four straight years. Carnell Tate could make it five in 2026.
